island.walkHint: Tap the meadow – your keeper walks there.

himmelsdock.name: Sky Dock
himmelsdock.desc: The heart of your island. Upgrading it unlocks new buildings and raises their level cap.

windmuehle.name: Wind Mill
windmuehle.desc: Grinds the spores drifting in the updraft into nourishing skygrain.

hain.name: Cloud Grove
hain.desc: Driftwood grows here – lighter than air and tougher than oak.

nebelbruch.name: Mist Quarry
nebelbruch.desc: Quarries miststone from the underside of the island.

speicher.name: Sky Storehouse
speicher.desc: Raises the storage cap for skygrain, driftwood and miststone.

wachtturm.name: Watchtower
wachtturm.desc: Scouts the cloud sea and unlocks expeditions. Higher levels improve the haul.

werft.name: Glider Yard
werft.desc: Builds and maintains gliders for expeditions. Each level raises the glider cap by 5.

kollektor.name: Aether Collector
kollektor.desc: Harvests aether from the air – far more productive at night and during aether rain.

expeditions.title: Expeditions
expeditions.subtitle: Send gliders into the cloud sea and decide what they encounter out there.
expeditions.lockedHint: Build a Watchtower on your island (Sky Dock level 2) to unlock expeditions.
expeditions.needsWerft: Build the Glider Yard to train gliders.

naheInseln.name: Nearby Isles
naheInseln.desc: A short flight to the shattered islets within sight.

nebelmeer.name: Sea of Mist
nebelmeer.desc: Dense veils swallow every sound – and many a secret.

sturmguertel.name: Storm Belt
sturmguertel.desc: Master the raging winds and return rich. Or not at all.

vergesseneHoehen.name: Forgotten Heights
vergesseneHoehen.desc: The ruins of the Ancients, high above everything. Few dare the climb.

explore.hint: Hold ◀ ▶ to walk · {{count}} aether sparks nearby

tips.1: The windstream changes every two hours – the forecast tells you what it favours next.
tips.2: The Aether Collector gathers far more at night. Good night, good harvest!
tips.3: Upgrade the Glider Yard – every level makes your crew stronger in battle.
tips.4: New aether sparks appear out here every two hours. Come back soon!

hunts.title: Beast Hunts
hunts.subtitle: Each glider fights with ⚔️ {{power}} combat power – upgrade the Glider Yard to strengthen them.
hunts.locked: Upgrade the Watchtower to level 2 to track sky beasts.
hunts.arrived: The battle is over – what happened?

nebelschlange.name: Mist Serpent
nebelschlange.desc: A pale serpent that ambushes supply convoys from inside the fog banks.
nebelschlange.won: After a wild chase through the veils, the Mist Serpent plunges hissing into the cloud sea – its hoard is yours.
nebelschlange.lost: The serpent strikes out of nowhere and shatters the formation. The survivors barely escape.

sturmrok.name: Storm Roc
sturmrok.desc: A bird of prey the size of a sailing ship. Its nest overflows with stolen treasure.
sturmrok.won: In the eye of the storm the decisive strike lands – the roc flees screeching, its nest lies open.
sturmrok.lost: A single wingbeat scatters your gliders. Retreat – this time it was stronger.

wolkenleviathan.name: Cloud Leviathan
wolkenleviathan.desc: Ancient, colossal, furious. A century of aether glitters in the furrows of its shell.
wolkenleviathan.won: For hours you dance around the colossus, then it sinks roaring into the deep – its shell yields its treasures.
wolkenleviathan.lost: One sweep of its tail fin – and half the crew is history. This giant demands more strength.

treibgutFeld.title: The Debris Field
treibgutFeld.text: A field of beams, barrels and shattered walkways drifts between the clouds – remains of an island that did not survive the Sundering. Some barrels still look sealed.

results.ruhigeHand: With steady hands your gliders secure beam after beam. No losses, a decent haul.
results.reicheBergung: A daring flight! At the heart of the field your gliders find untouched supply crates.
results.abgestuerzt: A beam swings wide – one glider plunges into the cloud sea. The others save what can be saved.

verlasseneMuehle.title: The Abandoned Mill
verlasseneMuehle.text: On a lonely rock an old sky mill creaks in the wind. The door stands open, tools still lie on the table – as if the miller had only just stepped out.

results.volleSaecke: The pantry is full of flour sacks and dried fruit. A good find.
results.geheimlager: Behind a barrel: a trapdoor! Below it a secret cache of valuables and a small vial of aether.
results.morscheBalken: The cellar floor gives way. One glider is buried and barely recovered – the haul suffers.
results.sichererKurs: Your gliders leave the mill in peace and pick up a small, safe haul on the way back.

nebellichter.title: Lights in the Mist
nebellichter.text: Bluish lights dance inside the fog wall. The old songs warn of them – but they also tell of aether springs that shimmer just like this.

results.aetherquelle: The lights lead to an open vein of aether! Your gliders scoop up as much as they can carry.
results.irrlichter: Will-o'-wisps! In the dense grey you lose a glider and precious time before the crew finds a way out.
results.planTreu: Your gliders resist the temptation and bring the planned cargo safely home.

sturmreiter.title: The Storm Riders
sturmreiter.text: A band of foreign glider riders crosses your course. They carry bulging cargo nets and eye your load with open interest.

results.guterTausch: A deal is struck: your charts for their cargo. Both sides fly off satisfied.
results.uebersTischGezogen: The strangers haggle like devils. Only later do you realise how bad the trade was.
results.gewonnen: Your best flyer wins the race by lengths! The storm riders grudgingly pay up.
results.verloren: A narrow loss! The stake is gone, and one glider limps home with a broken strut.
results.unbehelligt: You slip into a cloud bank and leave the band behind. Better safe than sorry.

aetherquelle.title: The Aether Spring
aetherquelle.text: Shimmering liquid aether trickles from a crack in a boulder and evaporates in the wind. A rare sight – and a temptation.

results.volleFlaschen: Bottle after bottle fills with pure aether. A calm, valuable day.
results.reicheErnte: The dam holds! Over hours a small pool gathers – a splendid aether harvest.
results.quelleVersiegt: The pressure finds another way: the spring runs dry before your eyes. Only a few drops remain.

alteBibliothek.title: The Old Library
alteBibliothek.text: Half sunken into the rock lies a library of the Ancients. Pages drift through broken domes like snowflakes. Much is lost – but not everything.

results.neueRouten: The salvaged charts reveal safe routes and forgotten depots. It pays off immediately.
results.verboteneFormel: Inside the archive: a treatise on aether binding! A treasure of knowledge – plus a pouch of aether dust.
results.staubUndAsche: The seal breaks, but everything behind it crumbled to dust long ago. At least the shelves make good firewood.

wolkenwale.title: The Cloud Whales
wolkenwale.text: A pod of cloud whales drifts majestically through the blue. Whole gardens of windweed grow on their backs – and their wake opens lanes through the mist.

results.krautgaerten: In the whales' wake you effortlessly gather drifting windweed – the nets fill quickly.
results.walruecken: The great one tolerates you! Its back gardens are full of fruit, and aether glitters in its furrows.
results.abgeschuettelt: The whale dives! One glider is thrown off and has to be abandoned. The pod vanishes into the grey.
results.stillerGruss: You fly along at a reverent distance. By evening you find a quiet little haul.

gestrandeteHaendlerin.title: The Stranded Trader
gestrandeteHaendlerin.text: On a tiny rock a trader crouches beside her wrecked cargo glider. She waves with both arms – then points meaningfully at her bulging freight.

results.dankbarkeit: Together the glider is quickly patched up. In gratitude she leaves you goods and a phial of aether – and remembers your island.
results.schnaeppchen: In her plight she sells far below value. A fat deal – though her gaze follows you for a long time.
results.ladenhueter: Back home it turns out half the crates hold worthless junk. She was craftier than she looked.

splitterinsel.title: The Splinter Isle
splitterinsel.text: An island shard full of glittering ore veins slowly sinks towards the cloud sea. In a few hours it will be lost – whatever you take must be taken fast.

results.sichereAusbeute: You free the outer veins and are long gone when the shard tips over. A solid haul.
results.erzregen: The core bursts in a rain of ore and miststone! The gliders catch whatever the nets can hold.
results.kollaps: The shard breaks apart too soon! Gliders fall into the grey – the survivors salvage only scraps.

stillerTurm.title: The Silent Tower
stillerTurm.text: A tower of the Ancients rises motionless from the clouds. No birds, no wind, no sound – only an open door and a faint pulsing deep inside.

choices.schwelleWachen: Camp at the threshold and trade

results.friedlicherHandel: Travellers use the tower as a resting place. You trade goods, stories and a few grains of aether.
results.herzkammer: Deep below beats a heart chamber of pure aether! You fill every bottle – a legendary find.
results.tuerFaelltZu: The door slams shut behind the vanguard! Hours pass before the mechanism releases – one glider is never found.
